avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces olaparib plasma concentrations, decreasing efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue St. John's Wort; use alternative mood support if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases olaparib concentrations and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid completely; substitute with other antioxidant supplements if desired

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle (Silymarin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition may modestly increase olaparib levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased toxicity; may use with dose awareness

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acid supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive anti-platelet effects; minimal clinical significance at standard doses
caution_supplements.action: Use standard doses; monitor for unusual bleeding

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases olaparib bioavailability and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit and juice; choose alternative citrus fruits

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase olaparib absorption; food effect varies based on formulation
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food; maintain uniform dosing pattern

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous vegetables (broccoli, cabbage, Brussels sprouts)
caution_foods.mechanism: Contain compounds that may induce CYP3A4 metabolism if consumed in very large quantities
caution_foods.action: Normal dietary consumption acceptable; excessive intake should be consistent

monitoring_notes: Olaparib is a substrate of CYP3A4 with significant interaction potential; monitor for signs of toxicity (anemia, GI effects, myelosuppression) when any CYP3A4 modifiers are used. Maintain consistent dietary patterns and report any new supplements or herbal products to oncology team.
